shortDescription: The Nikkei 225 Index dropped 467 points or 0.70 percent on Tuesday to close at 65933 points.Losses were led by Citizen Holdings (-12.26%), Casio Computer (-9.29%) and JTEKT (-7.72%).Offsetting the fall, top gainers were Softbank (6.72%), Nitori Holdings (6.31%) and Idemitsu Kosan (2.97%).

children: The Nikkei 225 Index dropped 467 points or 0.70 percent on Tuesday to close at 65933 points.

title: The Nikkei 225 Index Closes 0.70% Lower
